In Healthcare & Life Sciences, iot, digital twin & robotics bridges the physical and digital enterprise: industrial sensor network, digital twin platforms, computer vision and edge ai, predictive maintenance, robotics and autonomous systems integration, connected products, and smart infrastructure. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: industrial iot & sensor network, digital twin platform engineering, computer vision & edge ai — delivered on Dataq Twinverse and Dataq Nexus with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Clinician burden and documentation debt
Physicians spend hours daily on notes, orders and inbox; burnout drives attrition. Documentation AI exists but stalls on integration with the EHR and on compliance sign-off.
Prior authorization and RCM friction
Prior auth, coding and denial management consume staff across payer-provider boundaries. Denials arrive for documentation that existed but was never surfaced.
Interoperability gaps despite FHIR mandates
Imaging, genomics, claims and social determinants live in separate estates; exchange compliance is achieved technically but decision support still reads silos.

blocks.x: Two regimes anchor the control design here: GDPR / EU health-data regimes and GDPR / EU health-data regimes. Special-category data, DPIAs and cross-border transfer controls. Evidence for both is generated by the delivery itself — control tests, replay trails and documentation are artifacts of the program, not a reconstruction project.

Below is the delivery cadence for this capability — the same pattern on every engagement. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
